annotations.title: Look up possible FDA records for a device

tools.description: Use this when a person has a device in hand (a photographed label, a model name, a K-number or UDI) and needs the matching FDA records. Read-only; no model call. Give what was read from the photo or label (device_name, model, manufacturer, k_number, udi or gtin, product_code; at least one) and get up to 3 possible FDA records from openFDA (510(k), registration & listing, UDI), each with why_matched and why_not_matched, plus this week's change, recent recalls and the report count for the top product code, each with its openFDA link. status is needs_person_to_confirm, no_match_found or search_failed. `confirmed` is always null: a person confirms one record, or none. Example questions: 'I photographed a label: Welch Allyn 802 LTR - which FDA records match?'; 'Which device is K123456?'; 'Find the FDA record for UDI (01)00380740000004(17)261231.'.

k_number.description: 510(k) number printed on the label: K plus six digits.

product_code.description: Three-letter FDA product code, if known.
